name: Bfizz

PRESERVATIVES (INS211, INS202), FOOD COLOURS (INS150d, 102) AND ANTIOXIDANT (INS300 CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL AND SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOURS UNS150d, INS102) AND ADDED FLAVOURS (NATURE-IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (MALT (FERMENTED), HOP)
